name: awards
description: A row of award, rating and compliance badges. Logos only, no copy. Sits between major sections as a trust strip.

items.description: Badges. Each entry: `image` (URL, required), `alt` (required), optional `url` to link the badge, and optional `w` (badge width in px per step: d desktop, t at 1279px, m at 767px, s at 480px — the row layout sizes each badge as live does). The hub and eduhub layouts draw each badge at one size at every width: `w` (a number, or the d of the per-step object), plus `h` (height in px, hub only) and `radius` (corner radius in px, hub only).

title.description: Visually-hidden heading naming the group, for screen readers.

layout.description: wrap: centred rows that wrap (homepage). row: one centred row of 100px badges (product pages). spread: one row edge to edge (earlier hub build). hub: the Government, Healthcare, Construction and Manufacturing hubs (live #ap-gov-awards, ported whole: one row edge to edge, each badge at its own w x h, a marquee from 1024px down). eduhub: the Education hub (live #ap-eduhub-awards, ported whole: a centred row of badges up to 64px tall, a marquee from 1024px down, tighter padding on phones). The hub layouts follow live and do not stagger the badges in.

reveal.description: Stagger the badges in on scroll.
